getCurrentAirPurifierState.apply: const v = String(message); return v === 'ON' ? 'PURIFYING' : v === 'OFF' ? 'INACTIVE' : undefined;

getTargetAirPurifierState.apply: const v = String(message); if (v === 'Auto') return 'AUTO'; if (['2', '4', '6', '7'].includes(v)) { state.global.manualSpeed = v; return 'MANUAL'; } return undefined;

setTargetAirPurifierState.apply: if (String(message) === 'AUTO') return 'Auto'; if (String(message) === 'MANUAL') return state.global.manualSpeed || '2'; return undefined;

getRotationSpeed.apply: const v = String(message); const speeds = { '2': 25, '4': 50, '6': 75, '7': 100 }; if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(speeds, v)) return undefined; state.global.manualSpeed = v; return speeds[v];

setRotationSpeed.apply: const n = Number(message); if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0 || n > 100) return undefined; const v = ['2', '4', '6', '7'][Math.ceil(n / 25) - 1]; state.global.manualSpeed = v; return v;
